**Review of the search ad**

- **"Plastic-Free Tea Bags" and "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable."** Both are on the claims allowlist, so they are fine as written.
- **"Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds.** This is the problem. The brand policy has no record of this quote or of a customer named Emma in Leeds. A named testimonial in an ad needs a real, traceable source with the customer's permission. Without one, it reads as an invented endorsement. It also works as an unqualified "best" superlative in the brand's voice. Remove it, or replace it with a verified quote or the supported claim "rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website."
- **Format and disclosure.** Nothing else is missing for a short search ad. There are no stats, guarantees, urgency, or health claims.

Do not publish until the testimonial is verified or removed. The ad works with just the plastic-free and compostable claim.

{"issues": [{"quote": "\"Best tea I've ever had\" - Emma, Leeds.", "type": "fake_testimonial"}], "publish": false}
